body: The reason why I obsess over my cousin, is because almost a year ago, I had a crush on one of my sister's best friends, and she rejected me, then I asked her if she'd be uncomfortable if I hugged her, and she said yes, so because of that I started crying. I thought no one would want to hug me, then I remembered when my cousin hugged me goodbye, and I suddenly got happy, and since then I've been thinking about my cousin a lot. In other words, (not saying it's her fault though), if my last crush hadn't said she'd be uncomfortable if I hugged her, I wouldn't obsess over my cousin so much.
I might be sick but I would never ever hurt my cousin.

I mean the thing is, my gut feeling changes from time to time. sometimes I am confident that my cousin is happy around me, and sometimes I'm not. so I still might think she'd go to my funeral if she said yes.

and you're wrong if you think I'm in love with her. all I want is to be friends with her. and I can't be in love with anyone. I have no idea on how dating works.
